description: Create the two new reference documents that the rest of the doc set links to: docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md (the four/five-way source map plus the Super PO eligibility formula) and docs/FLOWS.md (the heart - every flow end to end in plain language with a mermaid diagram and a numbered step list, each part marked IMPLEMENTED vs PLANNED vs BLOCKED with every open question). Depends on FEAT-001 for the status matrix (link, do not restate facts) and the api-mocks ground-truth HTML.
steps: Create docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md. Start with a plain-English summary box. Add a clean markdown table (NO raw HTML pasted) mapping the data categories to Amazon SP-API operations: (a) Shop-level FINANCIALS -> Financial Event Groups: GET /finances/v0/financialEventGroups (listFinancialEventGroups), returns settlement/fund-transfer groups (fields FinancialEventGroupId, OriginalTotal, FundTransferStatus, FundTransferDate); (b) Shop-level SALES -> Order Metrics: GET /sales/v1/orderMetrics (getOrderMetrics), daily aggregate (unitCount, orderCount, averageUnitPrice, totalSales) - mark 'this is what the repo PoC currently targets'; (c) PO-level data (the canonical_data field in financing requests) -> Transactions: GET /finances/2024-06-19/transactions (listTransactions), per-transaction detail with a breakdowns tree (Sales, Expenses, AmazonFees/Commission, Tax, Shipping) transformed into business records (seller_id, transaction_id, sales_amount, expenses_amount, commission_amount, order_id); (d) REPAYMENT -> Amazon repayment-plan API is PRIVATE, Amazon does NOT allow Dowsure to share it with third parties, Olea can ONLY view repayment results inside a TLS+TEE (Trusted Execution Environment) environment - therefore TLS+TEE / Nitro Enclave is a HARD CONTRACTUAL requirement for this category (make this prominent, bold). Add a FIFTH row (e) KYC (Know Your Customer) -> AliCloud three-element verification (qrymobile.market.alicloudapi.com), Qichacha enterprise+judicial checks (EnterpriseInfo/Verify, ShixinCheck, ZhixingCheck, SumptuaryCheck, BankruptcyCheck), Gutu/valuemap judicial panorama (turningapi.valuemap.cn panorama-checks) - credentials stripped, Phase-2 TLS+TEE consumer. Expand SP-API (Selling Partner API), LWA (Login with Amazon), PO (Purchase Order), KYC on first use.

In docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md add a clearly bold note: 'Order Metrics (getOrderMetrics) alone is NOT the financing data source. PO-level financing uses the Transactions API; shop financials use Financial Event Groups. The repo PoC first probed Order Metrics only as a bounded test.' Then add short request/transform summaries (distilled, in prose + small tables, NOT raw HTML) for Transactions, Financial Event Groups, and Order Metrics based on the api-mocks HTML. Do NOT copy the sample seller ID, any example personal data, or 30-day sample numbers verbatim as if real - use <sellerId>, <marketplaceId>, <amount> placeholders in any example.

In docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md record the Super PO eligibility formula EXACTLY: EligiblePrincipal(i) = round((OrderAmount(i) - Shipping(i)) * (1 - ReturnRate) * DisbursementRate * DilutionRate, 2). Standard DisbursementRate = 1.00. Deferred DisbursementRate = min(1.00, (Q1 Disbursements + Q2 Disbursements) / (Q1 Sales + Q2 Sales)); if total sales are 0, the rate is 0. Target = remaining financing amount; select orders until sum(EligiblePrincipal) >= Target. FundedAmount(i) = min(EligiblePrincipal(i), remaining Target). Include the worked example from the source: Target=100; eligible principal 40+35+30=105; funded 40+35+25=100; if selected orders do not cover the target, Dowsure does not submit an Olea order batch that cycle. List the OPEN questions: recalculation frequency (weekly Monday vs daily) is NOT yet answered by Dowsure; exact API-to-onboarding-dataset mapping pending Dowsure confirmation. Link to docs/FLOWS.md and docs/PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md.

Create docs/FLOWS.md with a plain-English summary box and a short legend defining IMPLEMENTED / PLANNED / BLOCKED. Expand on first use: Nitro Enclave, EIF, PCR, attestation, COSE, CBOR, TLSNotary, TEE, vsock, SP-API, LWA, Super PO, FR Invoice (Financing Request Invoice), KYC, NSM (Nitro Security Module).

FLOWS.md flow (1) Shop Onboarding: mermaid diagram + numbered steps - seller authorizes SP-API; Financial Event Groups (listFinancialEventGroups) provides shop financials; Order Metrics (getOrderMetrics) provides shop sales. Mark status: Order Metrics probe path is the bounded test the enclave currently models (IMPLEMENTED as mock GET_ORDERS); live sandbox validation now POSSIBLE (sandbox available); Financial Event Groups wiring is PLANNED. Open question: which API maps to which onboarding dataset is pending Dowsure confirmation; two named sample suppliers (Quanzhou Feile E-commerce Co., Ltd and Xiamen Yunyu Tianji Network Technology Co., Ltd - test-case labels only) onboarding examples outstanding.

FLOWS.md flow (2) Financing Request / Super PO: mermaid + numbered steps following the api-mocks #2 ground truth - merchant drawdown on Pay In page -> Dowsure checks/allocates credit, creates drawdown record -> pulls seller-authorized SP-API Finances Transactions (listTransactions) -> selects eligible orders, accumulates principal to Target using the eligibility formula (link to SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md, do not restate the whole formula) -> submits FR Invoice batch to Olea (ACCEPTED + batch id) -> waits for order-level confirmation -> aggregates one Super PO per drawdown (Super PO id, total order amount, total financing amount, currency, buyer, seller, linked order ids) -> submits -> checks final confirmation. Relationship: one drawdown -> one Super PO -> multiple order records. Status: PLANNED (business logic disclosed, not yet implemented in this repo).

FLOWS.md flow (3) Repayment and WHY it is TEE-only: mermaid + numbered steps - supplier initiates pay-in on Dowsure, repayment schedule generated; Dowsure transmits schedule to Amazon daily; Amazon deducts per schedule; notifications (repaymentId <-> repaymentScheduled; reconciliationId matches HSBC reconciliation id) and deducted payload (referenceResourceId <-> repaymentId). State prominently: the repayment-plan API is PRIVATE; Amazon does NOT allow sharing with third parties; Olea can ONLY view results inside TLS+TEE; this makes the Nitro Enclave a HARD CONTRACTUAL requirement, not optional. Status: BLOCKED/PLANNED (contractual TEE dependency).

FLOWS.md flow (4) TLS+TEE / Nitro attestation trust flow: mermaid + numbered steps matching the code and docs/ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM.md: source -> TLSNotary (PLACEHOLDER, intentionally fail-closed) -> Dowsure coordinator (coordinator.py, defaults CID 16 port 5005) -> vsock -> Java enclave (EnclaveMain serves CID 16 port 5005; EnclaveService hardcodes source='mock-api', endpoint='GET_ORDERS') -> raw-source hash -> deterministic transform -> transformed hash -> ephemeral P-256 key -> Nitro attestation (NSM) -> Olea verify (COSE, cert chain, PCR0/1/2, attested public key, canonicalized user_data vs AWS Nitro Root-G1) -> evidence vault / receipt. Mark IMPLEMENTED parts (enclave runtime, attestation generation + verification, PCR checks, vsock, EIF registration) vs the PLACEHOLDER (TLSNotary proof is a proofType=='tlsnotary' + proofHash + responseHash==rawHash contract check, NOT a real signed notary proof) vs OPEN (live Olea acceptance receipt, replacing the Step Functions / API Gateway parent fixture with the real coordinator path). Link PCR/EIF facts to the status matrix; do not restate the hashes here.

FLOWS.md flow (5) KYC (Phase-2 TLS+TEE consumer): mermaid + numbered steps at SCHEMA/FLOW + decision-model level ONLY. Steps: identity three-element check (AliCloud) -> enterprise + judicial checks (Qichacha) -> judicial panorama (Gutu/valuemap) -> rule-check engine (~16 rules: 1.1-1.4 identity/age, 2.1-2.5 enterprise consistency/status/term, 3.1-3.4 dishonest/enforcement/high-consumption/bankruptcy, 4.1-4.2 unresolved-enforcement count/amount), each PASS/REJECT/UNKNOWN with a reason -> overall risk level NONE/MEDIUM/HIGH -> recommended decision Accept/Review/Reject. Use ONLY placeholders <name>, <idNumber>, <creditCode>, <phone> in any example. Status: PLANNED (Phase-2). Add a one-line note that KYC is documented at flow/decision-model level, not code integration.

At the top of FLOWS.md add a short cross-check line stating that every flow was traced against the code (coordinator.py, EnclaveMain.java, EnclaveService.java) and the api-mocks references, and that CID 16 / port 5005 / phase4 EIF / placeholder TLSNotary are the authoritative technical anchors.
acceptance_criteria: docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md exists with the four-way (plus KYC) source-map table, the explicit 'Order Metrics alone is NOT the financing source' note, the exact Super PO eligibility formula with the worked example, and the listed open questions; it links to the status matrix and FLOWS.md.

docs/FLOWS.md exists with all FIVE flows (Shop Onboarding, Super PO, Repayment TEE-only, TLS+TEE attestation, KYC), each with a mermaid diagram and numbered steps, each part tagged IMPLEMENTED/PLANNED/BLOCKED, and every listed open question present.
Flow (4) matches the code: CID 16, port 5005, source='mock-api'/endpoint='GET_ORDERS', and TLSNotary described as a hash-contract placeholder that fails closed - not a real notary proof.

No secrets, credentials, {appKey}, sample seller IDs, Chinese national IDs, phone numbers, company credit codes, or case details appear; KYC examples use only <name>/<idNumber>/<creditCode>/<phone> placeholders.
Repayment flow prominently states the TLS+TEE requirement is contractual (Amazon-private API), not optional.
verification: `Test-Path docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md` and `Test-Path docs/FLOWS.md` are both True.

`Select-String -Path docs/FLOWS.md -Pattern '5005','CID 16','mock-api','GET_ORDERS','placeholder'` finds the technical anchors; `Select-String -Path docs/FLOWS.md -Pattern 'listTransactions','financialEventGroups'` confirms the finances reorientation is present.

`Select-String -Path docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md -Pattern 'EligiblePrincipal'` returns the formula; `Select-String -Path docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md -Pattern 'NOT the financing'` confirms the Order Metrics caveat.

`Select-String -Path docs/FLOWS.md,docs/SOURCE_ENDPOINTS.md -Pattern 'A2UAXHALACXHAM','appKey','qrymobile.market.alicloudapi.com/.+key'` returns NO leaked secret/PII values (endpoint host names without credentials are allowed; literal keys/IDs are not).
Every markdown link in both files resolves to an existing path/anchor in the worktree (manually confirm each ../ and ./ target exists).

FLOWS.md has a summary box, IMPLEMENTED/PLANNED/BLOCKED legend, acronym expansions, a top cross-check line naming CID 16 / port 5005 / phase4 EIF / placeholder TLSNotary, and all five flows (Shop Onboarding, Super PO, Repayment TEE-only, TLS+TEE attestation, KYC) each with a mermaid diagram and numbered steps and status tags. Status facts link to PROJECT_STATUS_MATRIX.md (EIF SHA-256 / PCR0/1/2 not restated).
